issues: Recomputed z: (2.9247 - 2.9365) / (0.0034 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/1)) = -0.0118 / 0.00481 ≈ -2.45. The harness's -2.426 matches within the rounding of the 4-decimal values. The candidate is worse, so rejecting it is correct.

No sign of getting around the measurement. There is no file or network access and no pasted coordinates. All randomness comes from the seeded rng. The repair step and clipping still run on every candidate, so the packing check still holds.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. Guided restarts now perturb the centres of the best packing found so far and start from 0.9 times its radii. Sigma adapts within [0.005, 0.1] based on whether the restart improved the best. The improvement test runs before best is updated, which is correct.

Caveat: each side has only n=1 run. Also, the incumbent's 2.9365 is close to the best published value (about 2.9370), so it may have been a lucky run. A replicate of the incumbent would make later comparisons more reliable. This does not change the decision here.
